name: RoomDataModelAndRegistry
key_decisions: Room is a @dataclass(frozen=True) with id, bg_color, neighbors fields
ROOMS is a module-level dict authored in insertion order yellow, blue, green, purple
START_ROOM = 'yellow'; ROOMS[START_ROOM].bg_color == ROOM_COLOR == (240, 208, 64) preserves T1/T2 visuals
neighbors[dir] is None encodes sealed; a string id encodes passage
C01 does NOT validate at import; validators (C02) are called once at registry-construction in C06
risks: Authoring error in adjacency (R6) — mitigated by C02 validators called from C06
